description: Local Codex adapter (Agent Plugins format). Bundles the platform-neutral UI/UX Skill as a Codex/OpenAI Agent Plugin with MCP tool exposure through the shared stdio transport.

knowledge.rule: Load SKILL.md first; retrieve knowledge by id or collection through retrieve_knowledge, never whole folders.

bundle_layout.note: The full generic package is the plugin root; the packaged skills/ui-ux-workflow/SKILL.md delegates to the canonical SKILL.md (no copy).

limitations: Requires local Python environment to run the shared MCP server.
Not yet tested for public OpenAI Plugin distribution (local workspace testing only).
